title: Queen
scene: early-1970s British hard rock / art rock
notes: Hard-edged debut with guitar orchestration, layered harmonies and fantasy narratives.

title: Queen II
notes: Dark fantasy suites driven by enormous guitar layers, piano and choral vocals.

title: Sheer Heart Attack
notes: Sharper songs join distorted rock, ornate cabaret and densely stacked studio harmonies.

title: A Night at the Opera
scene: 1970s British art rock / music hall crossover
notes: Studio maximalism combines operatic choirs, music hall, hard rock and intricate ballads.

title: A Day at the Races
scene: 1970s British theatrical hard rock and arena rock
notes: Dense harmonies, gospel grandeur and hard guitar riffs in a streamlined sequel.

title: News of the World
scene: 1977 British arena rock responding to punk and funk
notes: Stadium chants and lean rock alternate with punk, blues, Latin textures and funk.

title: Jazz
scene: late-1970s British theatrical arena hard rock with disco crossover
sounds_like: Electric Light Orchestra|The Sweet|Thin Lizzy|David Bowie
notes: Heavier layered guitars frame playful rock songs, rapid-fire piano and early dance experiments.

title: The Game
scene: 1980 Munich studio pop rock and American disco-funk crossover
notes: Funk bass, vintage rockabilly and cleaner pop production introduce Queen’s first synthesizers.

title: Flash Gordon
scene: British science-fiction film soundtrack; theatrical electronic rock
notes: Synth-heavy science-fiction cues weave film dialogue through heroic guitars and orchestral passages.

title: Hot Space
scene: Early-1980s Munich electro-funk, disco and new-wave crossover
sounds_like: Chic|The Isley Brothers|Duran Duran|Hall & Oates|The Jacksons|Talking Heads|KC and the Sunshine Band
notes: Electronic funk and dance grooves dominate; Bowie duet closes a polarising stylistic detour.

title: The Works
scene: 1984 British stadium rock and electronic new-wave pop
sounds_like: The Cars|Electric Light Orchestra|The Human League|Genesis|The Who
notes: Stadium rock guitars return alongside synth-pop anthems, machine rhythms and vocoder experiments.

title: A Kind of Magic
scene: 1980s cinematic stadium rock; Highlander-related songs and electronic pop
notes: Cinematic rock anthems, electronic dance textures and orchestral balladry follow Highlander themes.

title: The Miracle
scene: Late-1980s British arena rock and synth-pop crossover
notes: Collaborative studio rock balances muscular anthems, electronic singles and searching lyrics.

title: Innuendo
scene: British theatrical progressive and hard rock
notes: Complex progressive rock and direct guitar songs frame Mercury’s final lifetime studio album.

title: Made in Heaven
scene: Posthumous studio reconstruction; British melodic rock
notes: Earlier vocals reworked into reflective rock, gospel-tinged harmonies and expansive studio arrangements.

title: The Cosmos Rocks
scene: British-American classic rock; Queen + Paul Rodgers
producers: Brian May|Paul Rodgers|Roger Taylor|Joshua J. Macrae|Justin Shirley-Smith|Kris Fredriksson
notes: Rodgers-led blues-rooted hard rock, with May’s layered guitars and Taylor’s stadium rhythms.
